checking_rule: Only check a box when: (1) explicit acceptance criterion, (2) evidence from a real run or a deterministically re-runnable artifact, (3) independently re-checkable, (4) frozen into case/validation artifacts. 'Code written', 'should run', 'ran in another dir', 'looks fine' are NOT acceptable.
